type: Surface absorbed dose, galactic cosmic rays
screenNote: Measured on the rover at Gale Crater surface. NOT inside a spacesuit. Solar storms and suit shielding not modeled. This is a planning baseline only.
solarStormNote: Moderate solar particle event (SPE) scenario. RAD/Curiosity measured SPE events delivering 1–8 mGy in a single day (4–34× baseline). We use 10× as a conservative planning scenario. Hassler et al. (2014), Science 343, Supplementary Table S2.
